children: Treasure Global entered into a Software Development Agreement with Mestiz Technology to build a centralized Microsoft Power BI business intelligence platform across its lifestyle retail, loyalty ecosystem, and digital wallet businesses. The $2,000,000 engagement, which runs for one year on a non-exclusive basis, will be paid by milestones in cash, TGL common stock, or a combination. The project aims to turn operational and transactional data into actionable insights through centralized dashboards and reporting, improving performance monitoring, customer analytics, and risk oversight.
